Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 44791 of 2024
Applicant :- Premsheela Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kamlesh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Kamlesh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shatrughan Yadav,
learned Aga for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No. 312 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 34, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station
Sahjanwa, District Gorakhpur during pendency of the trial.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He next submits that actually daughter-in-law of the applicant after marriage conceived thrice but unfortunately all the times her miscarriage was caused and this time when she again conceived then she was having fear in her mind that this time again her miscarriage would cause and only due to this reason she was under depression and in depression and fear she committed suicide by hanging Premsheela Devi vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45613818/
1 herself.
5.

sentences.text: He further submits, post mortem report also suggests that deceased sustained one ligature mark around her neck and she died due to hanging.
He further submits, hyoid bone of the deceased was found intact, therefore, post mortem report also suggests that prima facie it appears to be a case of suicidal death.
6. He next submits, there is no specific allegation against the applicant and applicant is not having any criminal history and she is lady and in the present matter she is in jail since 24.07.2024.

7. He further submitted that co-accused Janardan Mishra, father in law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 29.11.2024 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 43040 of 2024.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 43040 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within three years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
He further could not dispute the fact that after considering the post mortem report, the possibility of suicidal death of the deceased cannot be ruled out.
9. He further could not dispute the fact that co-accused Janardan Mishra, father in law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, it reflects, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within three years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

12. Further, after considering the post mortem report of the deceased prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death and reason of alleged suicide given by the applicant in the instant bail application cannot be completely ruled out at this stage.
13. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 24.07.2024.
14. Further, co-accused Janardan Mishra, father in law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant - Premsheela Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
